snippet.title: Sker: The Bleeding Veil - Official Reveal Trailer | IGN Fall Fan Fest 2026
snippet.description:
Check out the Reveal Trailer for Sker: The Bleeding Veil, an upcoming first-person horror adventure game developed by Stormind Games and Wales Interactive. Players will embark on this brand-new sequel with new locations to explore, enemies to face, and secrets to make sense of. Sker: The Bleeding Veil is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).

#IGN #Gaming #FanFest
